summary: Picking what to link on the Access map is faster and nothing is written until you commit.

new.title: Pick links from a searchable list
new.text: When you start a link on the Access map, the candidates appear in a list you can filter by name or tag. Click entries to add them, then press Done.

new.title: See what is already linked
new.text: Items the selection already has are shown as already linked rather than hidden, so a missing group really is missing.

new.title: Links wait for Review & Save
new.text: Each pick becomes a pending change shown as a dashed line. You commit it on Review & Save, and it is backed up first and applied in your tenant straight away.
